declarations.description:
A horizontal slideshow of its children. Every child element is a slide; the track scrolls natively, so touch
swipes, trackpads and a focused track's arrow keys all move it, and CSS scroll snapping keeps a slide aligned to
the start of the viewport.

Previous/next controls sit over the track and a row of indicators below it, one per position the carousel can rest
at. How wide a slide is and how far apart slides sit are CSS variables (`--c2-carousel__slide--width`,
`--c2-carousel--gap`), so showing two or three slides at once, or letting the next one peek in, needs no attribute;
`index` then names the first slide in view and the indicators shrink to the positions that can actually be reached.
Hiding the controls or the indicators is also CSS (`--c2-carousel__control--display`,
`--c2-carousel__indicators--display`).

`loop` wraps previous/next around the ends. `autoplay` advances every `interval` milliseconds, always wrapping to the
first slide, and adds a play/pause control; rotation pauses while the pointer is over the carousel or focus is inside
it, and does not start on its own when the user prefers reduced motion.

Accessibility follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: the component is a region named by `label` with the
`carousel` role description, each slide becomes a group with the `slide` role description and a "2 of 5" name
(unless it already carries an `aria-label`), and the current slide is announced politely while rotation is stopped.
The indicators are one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between them.
declarations.name: Carousel

cssProperties.description: Width of one slide; `50%` shows two at once, `85%` lets the next one peek in.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__slide--width

cssProperties.description: Rounding of the viewport the slides scroll through.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__track--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Distance from a control to the edge of the track.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__control--inset

cssProperties.description: Colour of the play/pause control in the indicator row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__rotation--color

cssProperties.description: Space between the track and the indicator row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__indicators--margin-top

cssProperties.description: Where the indicators sit in the row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__indicators--justify-content

cssProperties.description: Width of the indicator of the current slide.
cssProperties.name: --c2-carousel__indicator__selected--width

cssParts.description: The region that wraps the whole carousel.
cssParts.name: carousel

cssParts.description: The row of indicators, with the play/pause control when `autoplay` is set.
cssParts.name: indicators

slots.description: The slides. Every child element is one slide.
Icon of the previous-slide control. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: previous-icon

slots.description: Icon of the next-slide control. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: next-icon

slots.description: Icon of the play control shown with `autoplay` while rotation is stopped.
slots.name: play-icon

slots.description: Icon of the pause control shown with `autoplay` while slides rotate.
slots.name: pause-icon

members.name: index
members.description: Zero-based index of the slide at the start of the viewport. Reflected, and clamped to the reachable range.

members.name: loop
members.description: Wrap previous/next around the ends instead of stopping there.

members.name: autoplay
members.description: Advance to the next slide every `interval` milliseconds and show a play/pause control.

members.name: interval
members.description: Milliseconds each slide stays on show while `autoplay` rotates.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the carousel region.

members.name: previousLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the previous-slide control.

members.name: nextLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the next-slide control.

members.name: indicatorsLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the indicator group.

members.name: indicatorLabelTemplate
members.description: Accessible name of an indicator. Placeholders: `{index}` (1-based), `{count}`.

members.name: slideLabelTemplate
members.description: Accessible name given to a slide without its own `aria-label`. Placeholders: `{index}` (1-based), `{count}`.

members.name: playLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the control that starts rotation.

members.name: pauseLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the control that stops rotation.

members.name: positionCount
members.description: Number of positions the track can rest at: slides past the last full scroll share the final position.

members.name: rotating
members.description: Whether the user has left rotation running; the play/pause control toggles it.

members.name: held
members.description: Hover or focus inside the carousel holds rotation without changing what the play/pause control shows.

members.name: resumedUnderPointer
members.description: Set when play is pressed under the pointer, so that same hover does not immediately hold rotation again.

members.name: scrolledIndex
members.description: The index the track rests at or is scrolling towards; `-1` when it must be re-aligned.

members.name: labelledSlides
members.description: Slides whose `aria-label` the carousel wrote, so it may rewrite it and never touches an author's.

members.name: count
members.description: Number of positions the carousel can rest at; one per slide unless several slides fit in the viewport at once.

members.name: currentIndex
members.description: `index` clamped to the reachable range; this is the slide the carousel actually shows first.

members.name: playing
members.description: Whether autoplay is advancing right now.

members.name: goTo
members.description: Show the slide at `index`, clamped to the reachable range. Fires `slide-change` when it moves.

members.name: next
members.description: Show the next slide; past the last one it wraps with `loop` and stays put without.

members.name: previous
members.description: Show the previous slide; before the first one it wraps with `loop` and stays put without.

members.name: offsets
members.description: Scroll offset at which each slide sits at the start of the track, clamped to the scrollable range.

members.name: measure
members.description: Count the positions the track can rest at: every slide from the first that needs the full scroll shares the last.

members.name: realign
members.description: A resize moves every snap point; re-measure and put the current slide back at the start without animating.

members.name: settle
members.description: The track stopped: whichever slide it rests closest to is now the current one.

members.name: restoreFocus
members.description:
Keep the keyboard where it was: the indicator that roved follows the current slide, and a control that the press
just disabled at an end of the track hands focus to the opposite one instead of dropping it to the document.

members.name: toggleRotation
members.description: Pressing play starts rotation right away, although the pointer or focus that pressed it is inside the carousel.

events.name: slide-change
events.description: Fired after the slide at the start of the viewport changes by a control, an indicator, the keyboard, a swipe, autoplay or a `next()`/`previous()`/`goTo()` call. Setting `index` does not fire it. Does not bubble.
